description: Represents a binding between a search configuration and an entity. Walk the entity hierarchy (entity → folder → project) to find the effective configuration.

bindId.description: The unique ID of this binding.

searchConfigurationId.description: The ID of the SearchConfiguration bound to this entity.

objectId.description: The ID of the entity this configuration is bound to.

objectType.description: The type of the object this configuration is bound to.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this binding.

createdOn.description: The date this binding was created.
